title: Cow reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Cow body -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="70" rx="25" ry="18" fill="#f5f0e8"/>
  <!-- Cow spots -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="65" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#4a4a6a"/>
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="75" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#4a4a6a"/>
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="78" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#4a4a6a"/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x="22" y="82" width="6" height="12" rx="2" fill="#f5f0e8"/>
  <rect x="36" y="82" width="6" height="12" rx="2" fill="#f5f0e8"/>
  <rect x="44" y="82" width="6" height="12" rx="2" fill="#f5f0e8"/>
  <rect x="50" y="82" width="6" height="12" rx="2" fill="#f5f0e8"/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x="22" y="91" width="6" height="4" rx="1" fill="#8b6e4e"/>
  <rect x="36" y="91" width="6" height="4" rx="1" fill="#8b6e4e"/>
  <rect x="44" y="91" width="6" height="4" rx="1" fill="#8b6e4e"/>
  <rect x="50" y="91" width="6" height="4" rx="1" fill="#8b6e4e"/>
  <!-- Cow head -->
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="52" rx="16" ry="14" fill="#f5f0e8"/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="44" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#f5c8c8" transform="rotate(-30 44 44)"/>
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="44" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#f5c8c8" transform="rotate(30 72 44)"/>
  <!-- Horns -->
  <path d="M48 40 Q46 32 50 30" stroke="#e8d48b" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M68 40 Q70 32 66 30" stroke="#e8d48b" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="58" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#f5c8c8"/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx="59" cy="57" r="1.5" fill="#8b4e4e"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="57" r="1.5" fill="#8b4e4e"/>
  <!-- Eyes (looking down at book) -->
  <circle cx="54" cy="48" r="3" fill="#4a4a6a"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="48" r="3" fill="#4a4a6a"/>
  <circle cx="54.5" cy="49" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="67.5" cy="49" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Book -->
  <rect x="62" y="65" width="28" height="20" rx="2" fill="#e85d5d"/>
  <rect x="62" y="65" width="28" height="3" fill="#f5f0e8"/>
  <line x1="76" y1="68" x2="76" y2="85" stroke="#c44" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Text lines on book -->
  <line x1="65" y1="72" x2="74" y2="72" stroke="#f5f0e8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="65" y1="76" x2="74" y2="76" stroke="#f5f0e8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="65" y1="80" x2="72" y2="80" stroke="#f5f0e8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="78" y1="72" x2="87" y2="72" stroke="#f5f0e8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="78" y1="76" x2="87" y2="76" stroke="#f5f0e8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="78" y1="80" x2="85" y2="80" stroke="#f5f0e8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Hooves holding book -->
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="78" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#8b6e4e"/>
  <ellipse cx="88" cy="78" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#8b6e4e"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M16 68 Q8 62 6 70 Q4 76 10 76" stroke="#f5f0e8" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="10" cy="76" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#e8d48b"/>
</svg>
